description: Qwen's text-to-speech model with nine built-in voices on one DGX Spark, served by vLLM-Omni 0.32.0 the way the Qwen3-TTS README points to. It answers the OpenAI speech route, POST /v1/audio/speech: pick a voice, optionally give an instruction for style or emotion and a speed, and receive wav, pcm, flac, mp3 or opus. Voice design and voice cloning are not on this route; they stay in the Qwen3-TTS job recipe. The deploy config is the creator's, verified by its authors only on an H100; its two stages (talker and codec decoder) each take the creator's 24 GiB converted to 0.197 of a Spark, so the 58 GB peak is an estimate until tried. Apache-2.0 weights.
title: Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B CustomVoice (vLLM-Omni, single Spark)
